```{r}
library(cfbfastR)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
install.packages("sdvplotR", repos = c("https://sportsdataverse.r-universe.dev", getOption("repos")))
```

```{r}
exports <- getNamespaceExports("cfbfastR")
families <- c("load_cfb_", "load_espn_cfb_", "load_ncaa_mfb_", "cfbd_",
              "espn_", "fox_cfb_", "yahoo_cfb_", "calculate_")
data.frame(
  prefix = paste0(families, "*()"),
  functions = vapply(families, function(p) sum(startsWith(exports, p)), integer(1)),
  row.names = NULL
) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
passing_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
   cfbd_stats_season_player(2026, team = "Maryland", category = "passing"),
   cfbd_stats_season_player(2010, team = "Maryland", category = "passing"),
   cfbd_stats_season_player(2007, team = "Maryland", category = "passing"),
   cfbd_stats_season_player(2025, team = "Maryland", category = "passing")) |>
   dplyr::group_by(team) |>
   dplyr::select(team,
                 player,
                 passing_completions,
                 passing_att,
                 passing_yds,
                 passing_td,
                 passing_int,
                 passing_ypa) |>
   arrange( desc(passing_yds), team)
```
